where: The Tinderwick Beacon — all three floors of the wick-key ascent to the lantern room
mood: The Beacon Stair — a bass that climbs a step every bar, a determined call, brass like banked embers and a bell glinting from the lamp far above.
_note: Classic twin: assets/audio/midi/specs/beacon-stair.json (104 BPM, 4/4, D Dorian, rising stair bass, 16 bars). Unconditioned: the tempo is the point.

retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
plucked sampled bass climbing stepwise up the scale, a step higher every bar
warm sampled brass stabs on the downbeats
a high bell glint at the top of each phrase
sampled 16-bit march snare on two and four with tom fills
climbing a lighthouse tower stair, steady resolve with a thread of tension
